note: Fallback copy of the roadmap. The source is the GitHub issues of MrYoshii/cometmesh with the label roadmap (lane = status: label, closed = done, milestone = release); roadmap.html reads them live and uses this file only when GitHub is unreachable. scripts/deploy-site.sh refreshes it. Only issues by the authors listed here are shown.

cards.title: Comet stands on its own
cards.text: Forked from wadamesh and renamed throughout: own name, repository and logo. Credits to wadamesh and MeshCore stay.

cards.title: Audiobooks and e-books
cards.text: Audiobookshelf streaming and downloads, books on the SD card, an EPUB reader.

cards.title: The Comet mark
cards.text: A comet whose tail is a mesh, drawn and animated the same way on every screen, e-paper included.

cards.title: Own servers
cards.text: cometmesh.org serves updates, the app store, language packs, map tiles and the USB Files page.

cards.title: ESP-IDF 5.5 base
cards.text: Arduino 3.3 on a current ESP-IDF: much more free memory, downloads three to four times faster. Out as test build beta_1.

cards.title: Releases and browser installer
cards.text: Per-board releases from one script, installed from the browser, updated over Wi-Fi.

cards.title: Board layer
cards.text: Every board in one folder behind fixed interfaces, so a new device is a day of work instead of a week.

cards.title: T-LoRa Pager on the new base
cards.text: The first board to come over through the board layer.

cards.title: A UI made for e-paper
cards.text: One picture per keypress: pages instead of scrolling, no animation, keyboard first. Concept is drawn.

cards.title: Faster first GPS fix
cards.text: Keep position, time and satellite data across power-off, and fetch assistance data over Wi-Fi.

cards.title: Every mesh
cards.text: Meshtastic next to MeshCore on the same radio, one inbox for both, one screen to pick the active mesh.

cards.title: SMS and calls
cards.text: The A7682E modem: text messages, voice calls and mobile data for when there is no mesh.

cards.title: More boards
cards.text: Once the board layer has proven itself on the Pager.
